lines.zh: 根须挪一寸，土就松一寸。
lines.en: Each inch of root loosens an inch of soil.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，因为我还没长腿。
lines.en: I move slowly; I have not grown legs yet.

lines.zh: 别踩，我在往阳光那边挪。
lines.en: Do not step; I am shifting toward the sun.

lines.zh: 叶子拖在地上，走起来沙沙响。
lines.en: My leaves drag on the ground and rustle.
The soil is too hard; my roots cannot dig in.

lines.zh: 再挪半步，那边有块软泥。
lines.en: Half a step more; there is soft mud there.
I have not bloomed; first I learn to walk.

lines.zh: 别笑，长大以后我比树高。
lines.en: Do not laugh; I will outgrow trees.

lines.zh: 每一步都要用力，土在拽我。
lines.en: Every step takes effort; the soil pulls me back.
My stem is soft; wind tips me over.
Toward the water; my roots will feel better.
Where I pass, small pits remain.
Basking until my leaves grow hot.

lines.zh: 还有半天才到喂食的时候。
lines.en: Half a day until feeding time.
I am counting my leaves.

lines.zh: 泥土里有虫子在爬，好痒。
lines.en: Bugs crawl in the dirt; it tickles.

lines.zh: 嘴巴张着，等一块肉掉进来。
lines.en: Mouth open, waiting for meat to fall in.

lines.zh: 今天长高了一点点，真的。
lines.en: I grew a little today, truly.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我的叶片在鼓掌。
lines.en: When wind comes, my leaves applaud.
Water moves underground; my roots hear it.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，能听见自己长。
lines.en: In quiet, I can hear myself growing.

lines.zh: 隔壁那块土，看起来更肥。
lines.en: That patch of soil next door looks richer.
If I stay still, bugs dare come close.

lines.zh: 长大了要占满整片草地。
lines.en: When grown, I will fill this whole lawn.
A yawn opens every leaf at once.
The shadow moved; I should move too.

lines.zh: 肉味从那边飘来，我的根都动了。
lines.en: Meat smells drift over; even my roots stir.

lines.zh: 今天没人来，我把嘴合上一会儿。
lines.en: No one came today, so I close my mouth a while.

lines.zh: 一只兔子跳过叶尖，没有停。
lines.en: A rabbit hops over my leaf tip without stopping.

lines.zh: 我数着日子，等第二次喂食。
lines.en: I count the days until the second feeding.

lines.zh: 你手里提着什么？闻着像肉。
lines.en: What is in your hand? It smells like meat.

lines.zh: 蹲下来，让我看看你的脸。
lines.en: Crouch down and let me see your face.

lines.zh: 你的影子挡住我的太阳了。
lines.en: Your shadow is blocking my sun.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我牙还没长齐。
lines.en: Not too close; my teeth are still coming in.

lines.zh: 你比上次那个喂我的人高。
lines.en: You are taller than the last one who fed me.

lines.zh: 眼睛真多，我只有两片叶。
lines.en: So many eyes; I only have two leaves.
Will you stay and feed me?

lines.zh: 靴子踩在土上，声音很沉。
lines.en: Boots on soil make a heavy sound.

lines.zh: 我认得你的气味，上次也是你。
lines.en: I know your scent; you came last time too.
Lower your hand; I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 你的手臂，比虫子粗多了。
lines.en: Your arm is much thicker than a bug.
Do not leave; the soil is too quiet.
There is a tear in my leaf.

lines.zh: 别踩根，那是最疼的地方。
lines.en: Not the roots; that is the sorest spot.
I am not grown yet; be gentler.
Sap is leaking out; it is sticky.
I will remember that blow for a long time.
Even the soil shuddered.
It hurts so much my leaves curl.
You are going to crush me.
I have sunk a little into the soil.
When I am grown, we settle this.
Meat! I can see that meat.
Raw is fine; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 丢过来，我张着嘴等着呢。
lines.en: Toss it here; my mouth is already open.

lines.zh: 两天后我就长大了，快点喂。
lines.en: I grow up in two days; feed me quickly.
The half-day rule; I remember it.
This piece is too small to fill a tooth gap.
Do not fob me off with rotten flesh.
Just the smell makes my roots tremble.

lines.zh: 喂饱了，我就不咬你的靴子。
lines.en: Feed me well and I will spare your boots.
One more piece, just one.
You are crushing my leaf; it hurts.
Back off; my roots are not settled yet.
You stepped into my soil pit.
Do not push; the stem will snap.
A broken leaf takes ages to grow back.
One bump and the soil loosens.

lines.zh: 我不是故意挡路的，我走不快。
lines.en: I do not mean to block you; I cannot move fast.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰到我的花苞了。
lines.en: Your knee touched my bud.
Easy; I am softer than I look.

lines.zh: 再挤，我就把根缠你脚上。
lines.en: Push again and my roots wrap your ankle.
I am too young; I have not even bloomed.

lines.zh: 等长成大树那么高再说。
lines.en: Ask me when I am as tall as a tree.
My seeds will be carried off by wind.
Roots first; flowers come later.
Patience, I am still pushing new leaves.

lines.zh: 花开了才好看，现在不行。
lines.en: I will be handsome when I bloom; not now.
The plant next door has not bloomed either.

lines.zh: 种子要落到肥土里才行。
lines.en: Seeds must land in rich soil to grow.
I would rather not be picked, thank you.
When I make seeds, I will give you one.

lines.zh: 我的根须还短，抓不住它。
lines.en: My roots are still too short to grab it.
With my mouth? It would be swallowed.
What falls in soil belongs to the soil.

lines.zh: 根只会往下钻，不会抓东西。
lines.en: Roots dig down; they do not grab.
Pick it up quickly, and do not step on me.

lines.zh: 掉在我叶子上，我抖不掉。
lines.en: It fell on my leaf; I cannot shake it off.

lines.zh: 用叶子托一下，也许可以。
lines.en: Maybe I can hold it with a leaf.
The meat fell too far away to reach.
My stem will not bend that far.
Let the bugs carry it; they are diligent.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，是给我的吗？
lines.en: Something moves; is it for me?
A bug crawls near; open wide.

lines.zh: 那块肉会自己走过来吗？
lines.en: Will that meat walk over by itself?
I can smell the blood now.
Hold still; let me aim at you.
When hungry, I want to bite everything.
You wrecked my soil; stand still.
My leaves pull taut; ready to lunge.
You cannot escape; you are slower than me.
This one is bigger than the last bug.
My mouth is open as wide as it goes.
Stop poking me with that stick.
One more step puts you in reach.
Wait until it lands on the leaf.
Wrong wind; the scent drifts away.

lines.zh: 它躲在草后面，我看得见。
lines.en: It hides behind grass, but I see it.
Do not bite yet; wait for it to lower its head.
My roots are anchored; I cannot move.

lines.zh: 它每走一步，土就响一下。
lines.en: Each step it takes makes the soil sound.
In this shade I cannot see clearly.
It circles around; I will not chase.
Wait for it to reach over.
I bite when I count to three.

lines.zh: 别挡着我的光，我要看清。
lines.en: Do not block my light; I need to see.
Bitten; do not try to pull away.
Small teeth, but a tight grip.
That bite was practice.
My leaf tip lashes like a whip.
Too big to swallow, but I will bite.
My mouth snaps shut with a crisp sound.
Do not pull; my teeth will come out.
I bit bone; it is so hard.
Another bite; I am still hungry.
You run fast; my leaves cannot follow.
The seed split; here I am.
The soil is damp; perfect for rooting.

lines.zh: 有人把我按进草方块里。
lines.en: Someone pressed me into the grass block.
The light stings; let me squint a while.
My first leaf has opened.
This spot is wide enough to spread.

lines.zh: 我闻到了泥土和肉的味道。
lines.en: I smell soil and meat.
Skip the water; give me meat first.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片草地归我。
lines.en: From today, this lawn belongs to me.
Once my roots land, I stop moving.
I was thumb-sized when I sprouted.
Two days; only two days to grow.
My leaf edges are scorched; so hot.

lines.zh: 我没掉下来，我本来就长在地上。
lines.en: I did not fall; I grow from the ground.
Too much water will rot my roots.

lines.zh: 土被掀开了，根露出来了。
lines.en: The soil is blown away; my roots are bare.
Something stuck into my stem.

lines.zh: 这味道让我的叶子发抖。
lines.en: This scent makes all my leaves shiver.
No feeding for half a day; I am wilting.

lines.zh: 天上亮了一下，我缩成一团。
lines.en: The sky flashed; I curled into a ball.
No soil below; my roots find nothing.
